name: Castle Hill and the old town
summary: From the river up past the castle and through the cobbled old-town lanes, then back down. Firm surfaces throughout; the climb is the effort.
notes: Curated to avoid steps: it climbs by Thames Street rather than the shorter flights, so it stays usable with a pram.
Built from OpenStreetMap and a terrain model on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it yet, so surfaces are as mapped, not as found.
Central Windsor is busy with visitors; pavements around the castle can be crowded at midday.
